exceptions.reason: Debian 13 (trixie) packages of the official postgres:17.11-trixie base with no fixed version (2026-10-19 scan of the recipe's image: 62 HIGH/CRITICAL rows, 1 CRITICAL in libxml2, 58 affected and 4 fix_deferred, across util-linux, gnupg, libxml2, perl, ncurses, systemd and acl packages; 0 rows with a fix). The recipe adds nothing to the base except a gosu rebuilt with the pinned Go builder (its Go standard-library rows, all fixable, are gone). The database has no host port and is on the database network only.

Debian 12 packages of the debian:bookworm-slim base of the slim functions image (the supabase/edge-runtime v1.77.4 image only supplies the binary) with no fixed version (2026-10-19 rescan of the new image after the full apt-get upgrade: 58 HIGH rows, and 1 CRITICAL in zlib1g that Debian marks will_not_fix; the fixed-only pass is clean). The recipe applies every Debian update. The container has no host port; outside requests reach it only through Kong.

Debian 13.7 packages of the node:24-trixie-slim base and the font/library set with no fixed version (2026-10-18 scan, Trivy 0.76.0: 54 HIGH, 1 CRITICAL; the fixed-only pass is clean). Debian 12 packages of the supabase/supavisor 2.9.13 base with no fixed version (2026-10-18 scan: 379 HIGH, 10 CRITICAL in libaom3, libunbound8, libxml2, linux-libc-dev and zlib1g). The recipe applies every Debian update. Supavisor is in the optional pooler profile, on the database network only, with no host port.

Debian 12 packages of the python:3.14-slim-bookworm base with no fixed version (2026-10-18 scan: 61 HIGH, 2 CRITICAL in libsqlite3-0 and zlib1g). The recipe applies every Debian update. The bridge is in the optional sensors profile, on the default network only, with no host port, a read-only root and all capabilities dropped. This text records the 3.14 scan: it must be rescanned for the 3.15 base before the next release.

compensatingControls: No host port: outside requests reach PostgREST only through Kong, which requires the API key (key-auth), caps request bodies at 10 MB and limits each client address to 1800 requests a minute (docs/CONTAINER_SECURITY.md, REST request limit)
public.check_session runs before every request (PGRST_DB_PRE_REQUEST), and business data is written only through RPCs guarded by warehouse_security.authorize_rpc
The image is the publisher's v16.4 index, pinned by digest in Compose; another digest is not covered by this exception and fails the scan
exceptions.reason: The publisher's static PostgREST binary yields no package results in Trivy and the image carries no SBOM, so a clean scan proves nothing (TW-BE-010, option c). Planned replacement: a source build with a recorded dependency closure (option a). The historical aeson advisory HSEC-2026-0007 is unverified for v16.4.
